name: query-client
title: React Query client & provider
description: TanStack Query singleton with safe Next.js App Router wiring (fresh client per server request, one shared client in the browser) plus the provider component.
postInstall: Wrap the children of your root layout <body> with <QueryProvider> (src/components/query-provider.tsx). When consuming apits-generated clients, remember their ApiResponse<T> = [data?, res?] tuple: destructure with a null guard, e.g. `const [data] = await getProjects(); return data ?? [];`.
